FOOTNOTES

1/ Of the 163.8 FTE positions for fiscal year 2026-2027, 112.3 FTE positions are for division one and 51.5 FTE positions are for division two. (General Appropriations Act footnote)

2/ General Appropriation Act funds are appropriated as an Operating Lump Sum by Subprogram.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$25,550,900 and 163.8 FTE Positions from the General Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts include \$16,823,700 and 112.3 FTE Positions for Division I and \$8,727,200 and 51.5 FTE Positions for Division II. Adjustments are as follows:

Judicial Salary Increase

The Baseline includes an increase of \$252,200 from the General Fund in FY 2027 for full implementation of a pay increase for Court of Appeals judges.

The FY 2025 General Appropriations Act increased the Court of Appeals judge's salary from \$190,000 to \$200,000 on January 1, 2025 and to \$210,000 on January 1, 2026. The FY 2025 budget's 3-year spending plan included an additional \$252,200 in FY 2027 for full implementation.

Remove One-Time Equipment Funding

The Baseline includes a decrease of \$(10,000) from the General Fund in FY 2027 to remove one-time equipment funding.
